_comment: Shard job for the first training data: the run config of week 3 task 4 with the shard and reconcile stages on. Values in <...> come from task 4's run (the folders TSAI returns for clean, overlap and dedup, and the raw input folder the clean job read) and are filled in before submission. Tokenizer: TSAI's frozen p1536 (sha256 e6b93a93..., G3 train/p1536_s0_manifest.json, Kaggle sohiyiy/p1536-sample-v0), staged at teams/03-tokenizer/release/tokenizer.json. ledger.raw: the ledger runs in mode B, so every raw document is accounted for from raw to final (clean_action is never 'unknown') and a raw part that is not the one the clean job read stops the run. shards.packs: all 38 packs of the input manifest, listed here (from expected_inventory.json), not taken from the shard output, so reconcile fails when a pack's kept documents are in no shard. pack_table: pack_metadata.json, lane and licence (from G10's licence table) for every pack, written into every shard manifest. inventory: expected_inventory.json, checked by the pipeline before the shard stage and after reconcile (Gate 12). tokens: 2^26 per shard (shard format v1). F2 runs inside this job; TSAI confirmed no separate F2 job is needed.

clean.output: <folder TSAI returned for the clean job>

overlap.output: <folder TSAI returned for the overlap job>

dedup.output: <folder TSAI returned for the dedup job>

ledger.raw: <raw input folder the clean job read (the input manifest's parts)>
